line.a_koncert.text: Listen, I have news! Our parents are coming this afternoon. Let's play them a concert!

line.a_mamy.text: A concert! What a wonderful idea. Look, there is a drum and a bell in the garden.

line.a_ja.text: I'll play! I'll play loud and a lot!

line.a_halas.text: Oh dear, oh dear! Squirrel, that is not music, that is noise. Nobody knows what you will play next, so nobody can play along with you or dance to it.

line.a_jak.text: Then how do you play real music?

line.a_co_to.text: A rhythm? What is a rhythm?

line.a_rytm_to.text: A rhythm is something that repeats in order, again and again. I'll show you, it's a fun game. Listen, and watch every sound take its place in the row.

line.a_co_dalej.text: Drum, bell, drum, bell. Boom, ding, boom, ding. Listen again from the start. What do we play now? Point to the drum or the bell.

line.a_od_poczatku.text: Hmm, that doesn't fit. Let's listen from the start to hear what comes next.

line.a_dobrze.text: Yes! After the bell comes the drum again. Boom, ding, boom, ding, boom! The rhythm goes on.

line.a_moj.text: Now I'll make up a rhythm! Mine goes like this: boom, boom, ding.

line.a_moj_co.text: Boom, boom, ding, boom, boom, ding, boom, boom... What do I play now? Point to the drum or the bell.

line.a_moj_dobrze.text: Ding! That's right! Boom, boom, ding, and again from the start.

line.a_muzyka.text: Can you hear it? Now that is music! Everyone knows what comes next, so we can play together.

line.a_ozdoby.text: Our band can play now. But a concert needs decorations too. Let's make a garland of flags!

line.b_wieszam.text: I'll hang the flags on the string!

line.b_widac.text: A garland can have a rhythm too, one you can see. Let's look at it from the start.

line.b_cos_nie.text: Red, yellow, red, yellow, red... and red again? Something is wrong here. Point to the flag that breaks the rhythm.

line.b_ta_pasuje.text: That flag is in its place. Look from the start: after red always comes yellow. Which one doesn't fit?

line.b_ojej.text: Oops, two reds side by side! After red there should be yellow. I'll fix it.

line.b_teraz.text: Red, yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow. Now it's right!

line.b_dokoncz.text: There are three empty places left on the string. Drag the flags from the grass onto the string, so the rhythm goes on.

line.b_slot_nie.text: That flag doesn't fit here. Look at which colour comes after the one hanging next to it.

line.b_cala.text: Red, yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow, red, yellow, red!

line.b_gotowe.text: A beautiful garland! We'll take it to the kitchen for the concert.

line.c_posagi.text: Before we go on, let's play statues! While the music plays, we dance. When the music stops, everyone stands still, like statues.

line.c_pilnuj.text: And you are the judge! When the music stops, look carefully to see who is still moving.

line.c_kto.text: The music stopped, everyone stands like a statue. But somebody is still moving! Point to who moved.

line.c_jeszcze.text: Once more! The music plays, we dance. And you watch who moves when it stops.

line.c_nie_ja.text: I'm standing like a statue! Look who is still moving.

line.c_mam_lisek.text: Hee hee, I moved! You caught me!

line.c_mam_wiewiorka.text: Hee hee, I moved! You caught me!

line.c_mam_sowa.text: Hoo hoo, I moved! You caught me!

line.c_koniec.text: That was fun! Now let's go to the lake and invite Deer to the concert.

line.d_zaproszenie.text: Hello, Deer! This afternoon we're playing a concert for our parents. Will you come?

line.d_smutna.text: I'd love to... But everyone will be dancing at the concert, and I can't dance.

line.d_nauczymy.text: Don't worry, we'll teach you! A dance has a rhythm too: the moves repeat in order. Watch me.

line.d_co_teraz.text: Clap, clap, jump, clap, clap, jump, clap, clap... Which move now? Point to the card, and Deer will do it.

line.d_od_poczatku.text: Oops, not that move. Let's look again from the start at what comes next.

line.d_drugi_co.text: Clap, spin, clap, spin, clap... Which move now? Point to the card.

line.d_sama.text: A spin! Now I'll try it on my own: clap, spin, clap, spin.

line.d_umiem.text: I can dance! Thank you! I'll surely come to your concert.

line.d_do_domu.text: Hooray! Let's go home. Before our parents come, we'll have a rehearsal.

line.p_start.text: Time for a rehearsal before the concert! I have five rhythm games for you.

line.p_echo.text: The first game is an echo. Listen to me play.

line.p_echo_co.text: Boom, ding, ding, boom, ding, ding, boom... What now? Point to the drum or the bell.

line.p_od_poczatku.text: That doesn't fit. Let's listen from the start to what comes next.

line.p_echo_ok.text: Ding! After the drum always come two bells. You listen so well.

line.p_koraliki.text: I'm threading beads: red, yellow, blue. Drag the beads to the empty places, so the rhythm goes on.

line.p_koraliki_nie.text: That bead doesn't fit here. Look at which colour comes after the one next to it.

line.p_koraliki_ok.text: Red, yellow, blue, and again from the start. Beautiful beads!

line.p_blad.text: Somebody mixed up the leaves and the acorns. Listen to me read it from the start.

line.p_blad_czytaj.text: Leaf, leaf, acorn, leaf, acorn, acorn, leaf, leaf, acorn.

line.p_blad_wskaz.text: What breaks the rhythm here? Point to it.

line.p_blad_nie.text: That one is in its place. Look from the start: leaf, leaf, acorn. What doesn't fit?

line.p_blad_ok.text: Yes! There should be a leaf here, and there is an acorn. Now we know where the rhythm broke.

line.p_bebny.text: I have a big drum and a small drum. The big one plays low, the small one high. Listen.

line.p_bebny_co.text: Big, small, big, small, big, small, big... Which drum plays now? Point to the big one or the small one.

line.p_bebny_ok.text: The small one! Big, small, big, small. You can hear this rhythm and see it.

line.p_taniec.text: The last game is my dance. Watch carefully.

line.p_taniec_co.text: Jump, spin, spin, jump, spin, spin, jump... Which move now? Point to the card.

line.p_taniec_ok.text: A spin! After a jump always come two spins. We're ready for the concert!

line.e_girlanda.text: Our garland is hanging in the kitchen! Red, yellow, red, yellow.

line.e_bez_bebna.text: Oh no! The drum and the bell stayed in the garden. What will we play on now?

line.e_kuchnia.text: I have an idea! There are instruments in the kitchen too. The pot will be our drum, and a spoon in a cup our bell. Listen!

line.e_zaczynam.text: Our parents are here and sitting down. The concert begins! I'll start, and you play on.

line.e_graj.text: Now you! Play on: point to the pot or the cup, one after another, the way the rhythm goes.

line.e_od_poczatku.text: Not that sound. Let's listen from the start and play on.

line.e_brawo.text: Bravo! You're playing in rhythm with us.

line.e_druga.text: And now my song: boom, boom, ding. Listen.

line.e_graj_dalej.text: Play on, the way my song goes.

line.e_tancze.text: And I'll dance to your music, just as you taught me!

line.e_rodzice.text: Our parents are clapping! Make a concert like this at home together: a pot, a spoon and a rhythm, like boom, boom, ding. Or clap it: clap, clap, stomp.

line.naklejka_daj.text: Thank you for teaching me to dance! Here is a sticker for your album, to remember it by. Touch it to take it.

line.naklejka_juz.text: You already have the sticker from this adventure. See you!

line.naklejka_opis.text: This is the drum from the friends' concert. Deer gave it to us when we learnt about rhythm: in music, in a garland and in a dance.
